name: lpk-dev
description: Local development marketplace for the lpk and drawio plugins.

plugins.name: lpk
plugins.description: One coding request to a delivered change: a design an architect and a design critic review in at most three rounds, a test-first build where each slice reviews itself against the rule catalog, a dense parallel review net run by role - security, performance, accessibility, regression, bug hunt, UI - with a verifier ruling on each finding, proof on the running surface, and delivery gates that read only the evidence a run records. Plus a rule catalog, a findings ledger, the lpk Chrome DevTools server and a push guard. Loads from its plugin directory on any host that loads one, with no dependency on a particular assistant CLI.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Technical diagrams and charts as editable draw.io files plus PNG in one signature style, flat or isometric, where tones carry meaning and accents group.

plugins.name: lpk-mod
plugins.description: The owner's lpk commands in Claude Code: /lpk-switch saves the run state and points claude at another account, /lpk-waive releases a gate; a spawn hint and compaction instructions.
